# Camp Resource: Firewood Pile

When you need to throw another log on the fire just reach for this handy Firewood Pile!

- Collects Wood over time -

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Firewood Pile__

**Produces**

Wood scraps

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

40 wood scraps

**Obtainable via**

Season 12 Scoreboard - Rip Daring and the Cryptid Hunt - Free

Gold Bullion - Mortimer - Cautious - 1250 Bullion

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

#### **Flamingo Units**

2 Flamingo Units
